title.en: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: Architectural Synthesis & Enterprise SA Playbook on Google's Self-Improving Agent Harness Framework
title.zh-CN: Google《Harnesses That Improve Themselves》深度研究：自进化 Agent Harness 四组件双环架构、门控模块化演化与企业级 SA 选型指南

primary_source.title: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses

comparative_sources.title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
comparative_sources.authors: Hangfan Zhang, Shao Zhang, Kangcong Li, Chen Zhang, Yang Chen, Yiqun Zhang, Lei Bai, Shuyue Hu
comparative_sources.scope: Same-model 3-stage loop (Weakness Mining -> Harness Proposal -> Proposal Validation) across 9 bounded editable surfaces on Terminal-Bench-2.0, SWE-bench Verified, and AppWorld

comparative_sources.title: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement (RRSI)
comparative_sources.scope: Shrinking edit-size / diff / prompt-delta trajectory regularization preventing in-distribution task memorization
120-skill production audit (-79.2% prompt compaction, 1.2% -> 100.0% router visibility, Inverse Scaffolding Law on Gemini 4 Carbon & GPT-6.2 Sol)

inner_loop_components.role: Dynamic instruction assembly, working vs. experiential memory separation, head-tail observation compaction (>2 turns), live turn-and-edit status footer
Multi-turn event loop, turn budget cap (12 turns), JSON/tool parser, loop breakers, retry & subagent routing
Environment tool execution (bash, view_file, edit_file, finish), windowed file views, truncated shell outputs, pre-finish empty-diff guard
Lifecycle stop/check hooks blocking exit unless git diff is non-empty, edited Python files compile cleanly, and post-edit test runs pass

outer_loop_stages.mechanism: Clusters verifier logs and contrasts passing vs. failing multi-turn trajectories to separate recoverable runtime/harness bugs from intrinsic model limits

outer_loop_stages.name_zh: 受限模块补丁与钩子合成
outer_loop_stages.mechanism: Synthesizes targeted single-module Python patches or pre-turn/post-tool/pre-stop lifecycle hooks tied to recurring failure clusters

outer_loop_stages.name_zh: 执行覆盖与预算门禁验证
outer_loop_stages.mechanism: Enforces G_val(h, h0)=1 and E[C(tau)] <= B_tok (110k tokens): held-out validation split non-regression, runtime line-execution check of patched lines, and token ceiling

outer_loop_stages.name_zh: 集成合并与分支路由部署
outer_loop_stages.mechanism: Merges verified module updates into production harness or indexes specialized harnesses for bandit/router dispatch (e.g., MoSIB)

part_a_gemini_3_8_flash.verdict: Baseline 142-line Python seed; premature empty/untested exits and uncompacted file reads
Degrades accuracy (-2.5 pp) and doubles unverified OOD exits (15% -> 30%); text rules without runtime Python hooks fail under pressure
Buys +2.5 pp over modular via 28 uncompacted turns at 9.67x per-task token explosion (451.6k vs 46.7k)
8x seed accuracy, 0% unverified exits, 2.5x fewer tokens than seed, 9.67x fewer tokens than unconstrained; pays back 100 search rollouts in <100 deployment tasks

part_b_zero_shot_gemini_4_argon.verdict: Stronger instruction following avoids empty diffs, but burns all 12 turns reading uncompacted files
Modest gain on stronger instruction-follower, still lacks runtime compaction and verification gates
Drops from 42.5% -> 30.0% (-12.5 pp): Argon's longer reasoning chains compound catastrophically with 28 turns of uncompacted context
#1 accuracy on both repos (37.5% vs 30.0% unconstrained) at <1/4 token cost, proving lean code hooks transfer across model generations

modular_evolution_lineage.patch_summary: Compacts observations older than 2 turns into head-tail summaries + appends live turn-and-edit status footer
modular_evolution_lineage.impact: Cuts runtime tokens while lifting Dev and Val accuracy 5x

modular_evolution_lineage.patch_summary: Adds windowed file views, truncated shell outputs, and an empty-diff guard on finish
modular_evolution_lineage.impact: Eliminates premature empty-diff exits and bounds per-turn observation size
Dev accuracy jumps, but Val accuracy drops and runtime tokens breach the 110k B_tok cap -> blocked by Stage 3 G_val gate

modular_evolution_lineage.patch_summary: Pre-stop hook blocks exit unless git diff is non-empty, edited Python files compile cleanly, and post-edit test run succeeds
modular_evolution_lineage.impact: Reaches 40.0% held-out accuracy (8x seed) with 0.0% unverified exits at 46.7k tokens/task
